visual_review: VRECT_M: tall phone (20x28) with r4 corners, top and bottom bezel lines around the screen, and the middle of its top edge replaced by a flash burst (vertical ray plus two diagonal rays spreading to the keyshape sides), as in the reference where the rays break the top edge.
omissions: Phone shown whole (closed bottom with a bottom bezel) instead of cropped by the canvas, because an open-bottom body read as a stool/letter at 48; earpiece dashes and camera dot dropped (no 8-unit room between the rays, corners and bezel line).
